verdict.rationale: Airbyte is a data-movement platform with AI features (Connector Builder AI Assistant, Airbyte Agents), so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or contractual statement about whether customer data is used to train AI models. Self-hosting options are only an adjacent workaround and do not count as an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
